Those PATHS themselves are ALSO important interview discussion points.

Because interviewers may ask:

why this folder structure?
why workflows inside .github/workflows?
why Kubernetes YAMLs inside k8s/?
why separate deployment configs from application code?

VERY valid DevOps/backend architecture questions.

🔷 .github/workflows QUESTIONS
✅ Q1:
“What is .github/workflows folder?”
Answer

Special GitHub directory containing GitHub Actions workflow YAML files.

Used for:

CI/CD automation
builds
testing
deployments
✅ Q2:
“Why workflows stored inside .github/workflows?”
Answer

GitHub Actions automatically scans this path for workflow definitions.

Required default GitHub convention.

✅ Q3:
“What happens when YAML added inside .github/workflows?”
Answer

GitHub automatically registers workflow pipeline.

Can trigger on:

push
pull request
schedule
manual run
✅ Q4:
“What type of files stored in .github/workflows?”
Answer

CI/CD workflow YAML files.

Examples:

deploy.yml
test.yml
build.yml
✅ Q5:
“Why keep workflows inside repository?”
Answer

Pipeline becomes version-controlled.

Benefits:

reproducibility
team collaboration
auditability
🔷 k8s/ QUESTIONS
✅ Q6:
“What is k8s folder?”
Answer

Contains Kubernetes deployment configuration files.

Used for:

container deployment
scaling
networking
orchestration
✅ Q7:
“Why folder named k8s?”
Answer

Short form for Kubernetes.

Because:
“K” + 8 letters + “s”

✅ Q8:
“Why keep Kubernetes YAMLs inside k8s folder?”
Answer

Organizes infrastructure configuration separately from application code.

Improves:

maintainability
deployment management
DevOps structure
✅ Q9:
“What files usually exist inside k8s folder?”
Answer

Examples:

deployment.yaml
service.yaml
ingress.yaml
configmap.yaml
secret.yaml
✅ Q10:
“Why separate k8s configs from Flask code?”
Answer

Application logic and infrastructure configs are separate concerns.

Helps:

DevOps collaboration
environment management
scalable deployments
🔷 DIFFERENCE QUESTIONS
✅ Q11:
“Difference between .github/workflows and k8s folder?”
Answer

.github/workflows:

CI/CD automation

k8s:

Kubernetes infrastructure deployment
✅ Q12:
“What does .github/workflows control?”
Answer

Automation pipeline.

Examples:

build
test
deploy
✅ Q13:
“What does k8s folder control?”
Answer

Runtime infrastructure.

Examples:

pods
services
ingress
scaling
✅ Q14:
“How both folders work together?”
Answer

GitHub Actions workflow can automatically deploy Kubernetes YAMLs from k8s folder.

Flow:

push code
workflow triggers
Docker image builds
Kubernetes deployment updates
🔷 VERY STRONG REAL INTERVIEW QUESTION
✅ Q15:
“Explain end-to-end deployment flow using .github/workflows and k8s folder.”
Answer
Developer pushes code
GitHub workflow triggers
CI/CD pipeline builds Docker image
Image pushed to container registry
Kubernetes YAMLs deploy/update containers
Service/Ingress expose application
🔷 REAL PRODUCTION UNDERSTANDING

Purpose:
🚀 CI/CD automation

Controls:

builds
tests
deployments
✅ k8s/

Purpose:
☸️ Kubernetes infrastructure deployment

Controls:

pods
services
ingress
scaling
networking
🔷 WHY THIS IS GOOD FOR YOUR PROFILE

Because now you can discuss:
✅ backend
✅ CI/CD
✅ cloud deployments
✅ Docker
✅ Kubernetes basics
✅ infrastructure separation

That combination is VERY strong for backend/software engineer interviews now 🚀
